description:
A stock Ghost species in the Hollow Wood and Skull Hollow whose hanging, clothlike body distinguishes it from Gastly’s gas and Duskull’s mask. Insomnia or Frisk, with hidden Cursed Body, accompany a battle kit that can burn, exploit status and redistribute HP. These are inherited species properties; the northern addition does not define a local haunting origin.

It evolves into Banette at level 37 in the pinned native data. Banette has not been added to these wild encounter tables.
